card.name: Links between two compared things
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, and, from, differs) that sit between two items being related or compared, where a second item is about to be named. It also fires on the gap before a second dose or party.

modes.label: Relation between two parties
modes.description: A linking word such as to, with, or and after a relation or contrast between two entities.
modes.example: A sign is in a conjoint relation tothe thing denoted and<< to>> the mind.

modes.label: Differs from
modes.description: The verb differs or the word from right where a contrast with another item is stated.
modes.example: differs<< from>> any of the initial positions

modes.label: Between two doses
modes.description: The word and joining two doses or groups in a comparison or range.
modes.example: between the 18 mg<< and>> 36 mg dosages

card.writes: It suppresses words like intermediate, intermediary and direct, so it steers away from a middle or go-between term after the link.
card.plain: It marks the little word that joins two things being compared, just before the second thing is named.
